transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI is adding invisible watermarks to ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU, detectable only in long, unedited passages. Confirmed by BleepingComputer.
An ex-Anthropic researcher warned Congress that artificial intelligence is a threat, sparking debate and regulatory action in New York. Reported by Latin Times.
Still open, per CNBC: Jim Cramer says Microsoft leads Google and OpenAI in artificial intelligence sentiment.
The FTC is probing OpenAI and Anthropic as artificial intelligence agent safety risks draw scrutiny. Reported by TechRepublic.
Gorilla Logic joined Anthropic's Claude Partner Network to help enterprises integrate artificial intelligence into daily operations. Reported by 150sec.
